name: historical_life_period_overlap_with_known_endpoints_v2
description: Editable historical periods for the inherited/acquired audit. A person with both dates belongs to every period intersecting the closed life interval birth_year through death_year. When exactly one date is known, the person belongs to the one period containing that known birth or death endpoint; no additional years are inferred. Only both-date-missing records and death-before-birth records are excluded.
